svg.title: Jurisdiction aboard the Orbitaler Raumhafen
svg.desc: Nested layers show national internal jurisdiction within German integrated and emergency authority.
svg.text: Divided ordinary law · unified technical survival

g.text: traffic · docking · common utilities · structure · immediate hazards
administration · research · personnel · property · internal records
national unless conduct crosses modules or threatens shared systems
Emergency: Germany may isolate, evacuate, shed power, redirect traffic, or send responders.
After the hazard: national law resumes; diplomacy, insurance, and evidence-sharing follow.
